stops.note: meant 'maize', the base ingredient of a fermented beverage made by peoples of Panama and Colombia
adopted broadly by Spanish colonists as a generic term for indigenous fermented beverages
stops.meaning: a fermented maize or fruit beverage

stops.note: borrowed into English through travel and anthropological writing on Latin America
stops.meaning: a traditional fermented maize or fruit drink

current_meaning: a traditional fermented (or unfermented) beverage made from maize or fruit, popular across Latin America
